resources.string: Start the match on your watch
Open 「SCORECORE」 on your Galaxy Watch and tap 「Start match」. This screen becomes a live scoreboard. If auto-install failed, use 「Install on watch」 below.
Synced with watch · phone can score too
Tap A/B = point · Long-press = undo (synced to watch)
The watch owns scoring. Scores sync in real time via MessageClient (same package com.tanniscoring.app).
Watch paired · use 「Open watch app」 or launch from the watch
On Galaxy Watch, phone install often does not auto-install the wear app. Use 「Install on watch」 or install 「SCORECORE」 from watch Play. On phone Play use 「Install on Wear OS」.
Could not open watch Play. Use 「Install on Wear OS」 in phone Play, or install com.tanniscoring.app from watch Play.
No connected watch. Pair Galaxy Watch with the phone and try again.
Could not open the watch app. If missing, use 「Install on watch」 first.
Tap a match to start scoring on the watch. Tap the format chip to set that match to best of 1/3/5.
At deuce, next point wins the game (no advantage)
Open the watch app, choose Badminton, then Start. Scores sync here in real time.
Rally to 21, win by 2 · game ends at 30
